Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

Minion A hunts. Minion B plays Final Loosening. Can Minion B then
play Foul Blood?

Are Final Loosening and Foul Blood both played in the same window, and
therefore if two Meths want to play them, order is resolved via
1.6.1.5 as usual?

Thanks,
Ira

Final Loosening
Type(s): Reaction
Card Text:
Requires an anarch.
[aus] Play when the acting vampire would gain 1 or more blood. The
acting vampire and this reacting anarch each gain 1 blood instead.

Foul Blood
Type(s): Reaction
Discipline(s): Quietus
Blood Cost: 1
Card Text:
Only usable when a vampire controlled by another Methuselah
successfully hunts.

That vampire gains one less blood from the blood bank and takes 1
damage (damage not preventable). Tap this reacting vampire.

SUP: As above, but this reacting vampire does not tap.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ira...@gmail.com wrote:
> Minion A hunts. Minion B plays Final Loosening. Can Minion B then
> play Foul Blood?

No. Foul Blood's window is before Final Loosening's.

Like Spying Mission vs. burning Major Boon (Can't respond to Major Boon burning
with Spying Mission).

Hunt.
No (more) block attempts.
Hunt successful.
* Foul Blood
Resolve hunt
* Final Loosening
